title: Relative property (T) for uniformly bounded representations
summary: For pairs $(G,H)$, where $G$ is a locally compact group and $H$ is a closed subgroup of $G$, we introduce analogous versions of the full group $\mathrm{C}^*$-algebra and the Fourier--Stieltjes algebra for uniformly bounded representations. We use these objects to characterise relative property (T) in this more general setting in terms of Kazhdan projections and invariant means. We also show that, for semidirect products of the form $G=H\ltimes N$, where $N$ is a nilpotent group, relative property (T) for the pair $(G,N)$ is equivalent to its uniformly bounded version.
